spots.name: Driskill Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 163 m (535 ft).

spots.name: D'Arbonne National Wildlife Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Hot spring hiking trails
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.
